idea-plugin.name: Parquet Viewer - Query, Inspect & More
idea-plugin.description:
Parquet Viewer - Query, Inspect & More.

A fast, local-first IntelliJ Platform tool for exploring .parquet files without Spark, Hadoop services, notebooks, or uploading data.

Professional data workflow:
  • Open several Parquet files in independent tool-window tabs.
  • Browse paged data or use bounded-memory virtualized Show All mode.
  • Filter loaded rows with SQL-like expressions and correctly typed sorting.
  • Inspect schema, row groups, compression and column statistics.
  • Choose visible columns and export the current view or whole file to CSV or JSON.
  • Generate Hive DDL and Java POJOs from nested schemas.
All file IO stays on the local machine. Long-running work is cancellable and runs outside the IDE UI thread. License:
